note: Piece 1 of Quickstep: the feet before the name; the bay nobody could sit; the father's silence as consent. Kept off: a name for the father, the holding or the boys; the grey mare is only the long grey mare in the far field (piece 2 names the filly out of her for the thistles).
next_must_know: The grey mare in the far field is the one he rides off the hill to the muster in piece 2; she is the dam of the grey he will name, unnamed on the page; the bay is his father's and stays on the hill. He knows as a boy that the lances buy greys and never bays.

threads.note: Tale 1 p1: the long grey mare in the far field, unnamed; piece 2 names the filly out of her for the thistles.

note: Piece 2 of tale.quickstep. The filly named Thistle on the page, out of the unnamed long grey mare of piece 1; the father's brand on the dam and the lance brand on the near quarter planted; the muster town is on the Calden road at the foot of the hill road, never the Holloway (Edgemoor lies west); the Ninth's sergeant takes the boy on trial at the back of the string (the sergeant and the market town unnamed); the Ninth sings on the march, badly, all sixty (thread 11's first plant for 'the Ninth sang on every march'). Kept off: anything of the Grace; where Thistle goes; Aldric; the ford. The project is past its due day, so the last piece ends on the lesser keepsake.
next_must_know: Piece 3 gives the name (lesser keepsake: said once by one man in a yard and not taken up). He has walked with the Ninth's string since sixteen, on trial from the fifth milestone; the dam went down the Holloway with him and Thistle stayed in the far field (nothing of where she goes); the sergeant is unnamed. Tobin is not yet in the Ninth; the youngest then is unnamed.

note: Piece 3 of tale.quickstep, the lesser keepsake (the project finished after its due day): the word said once by the youngest, Darrow pretends not to hear, the sergeant withholds it with the carters' rule (saying.bynames spoken), nobody takes it up; what the Ninth came to call him stays untold on the page. Thread 15: how the grey came to him (his father would not sell her to the Ninth; the gate branded at the fair), nothing of her after the Wend. Thread 11 touched: the Ninth sings riding out; the worst singer waits for Tobin. The big knight is of an unnamed Calden lance, never the Sixth, so tale.hollis_table and tale.ninth_road keep their yard. Kept off: the Grace, Aldric, the ford, the knighting itself.
next_must_know: The tale is told in full. Its one allowed rhyme with the present is unspent (Book I's last line rhymed Tale 2, not this one); the keepsake's callback is the engine's. The name Quickstep has been said once on the page and never confirmed as his; if the present ever gives it, it is given by the men, and Hollis has only ever said 'the fastest feet in the Lowmarch'.
